title: fixpoint
description: A value left unchanged by a map, f(x) = x. On a complete lattice every monotone map has a least and a greatest fixed point (Knaster–Tarski); the least fixed point is the destination settling's monotone closure ascends to.

carrier.description: the complete lattice the map acts on, where the defining meet of pre-fixpoints lands

map.description: a monotone endomap f : carrier → carrier

fixed.description: f(x) = x; the least such is ⋀{x : f(x) ≤ x}, guaranteed by Knaster–Tarski
